articles.title: Hibs: David Gray 'will continue until told otherwise' - but has Hibs boss lost the fans?
articles.summary: Head coach David Gray says he will continue to try and find solutions to Hibernian's poor form "until someone was to say something different" after his side suffered a sixth consecutive home defeat in the Scottish Premiership.
articles.body:
Head coach David Gray says he will continue to try and find solutions to Hibernian's poor form "until someone was to say something different" after his side suffered a sixth consecutive home defeat in the Scottish Premiership.

Kilmarnock secured their first league win of the season thanks to George Stanger's first-half goal at Easter Road and held on despite a late red card.

The boos that echoed round the stadium were in stark contrast to Saturday, when Hibs eased aside League 1 pacesetters Ross County 3-0 to set up a League Cup semi-final against city rivals Hearts.

But club legend Gray realises that the latest league defeat, their fourth in six games overall, will see pressure mount, with his team now sitting ninth.

Struggling Kilmarnock condemn Hibs to sixth home loss in row

"It's clear to see, it's not good enough in terms of the result," the former Hibs right-back and Scottish Cup-winning captain told BBC Scotland.

"Nobody wants to hear me stand here and talk about the tactical side of the game at this moment in time. We have lost a game again at home.

"The only way it turns is by putting yourself out there, sticking together and believing in yourself and trusting your ability.

"One thing I will continue to do is work as hard as I can to turn this around. I've been through adversity before at this football club and I will continue until someone tells me otherwise. I believe in my group and believe in what we're doing.

"Until someone was to say something different, I will continue to do everything to turn this around."

For former Hibs midfielder Scott Allan, Saturday's visit by Aberdeen is now "a must-win" for former team-mate Gray.

"This won't go down well with the Hibs faithful," he said on BBC Radio Scotland's Sportsound. "It's the manner they lost, the level of performance, the amount of duels they lost, how easily it was for Kilmarnock to play through them.

"It was genuinely incredible at times, while going the other way they hardly created anything of note. That will not be accepted by the Hibs fans and certainly not David Gray."

When asked what is going wrong at Easter Road, former Scotland forward James McFadden said if he knew that, he would "phone David Gray and tell him".

"They are not starting games well, they are having to make changes, not making an impact," McFadden said on Sportscene.

"They couldn't find the breakthrough against a Kilmarnock side who have been leaking goals, but that's credit to Kilmarnock for the way they defended.

"Nobody can complain about Kilmarnock winning that game tonight. It is tough times ahead for Hibs."

Have the fans turned against club legend?

Kieron: Kilmarnock could have won by three or four and it wouldn't of flattered them. Hibs were so poor tonight. David Gray's position is hanging by a thread.

Stuart: The players on that pitch have to take as much responsibility as Gray for this result, nowhere near good enough. Amateur performance.

Andy: How can Gray continue to keep his job? The players are not playing for him. The club is a mess. Banning the only fans that bring an atmosphere. Benching three of our best players. So confusing.

Chris: Question the tactics. Thought for long time long ball is desperate and lacks ambition. Pressure indeed on David Gray.

Lee: If we end the game two points off bottom spot then it's surely time up for the Hibs manager. It's not a run and recovery from a bad position needed, it's deliver and results from the get go the support demands for a club of our size.

Stuart: The players on that pitch have to take as much responsibility as David Gray for this result, nowhere near good enough. Amateur performance.

Paul: Long balls to no-one as usual from Hibs and as usual our keeper is a weak link. Gray has to go even if we win as this is awful football. Bring in Neil Lennon or Steve Clarke asap before our season drifts to nothing as usual.

Brian: Worst backline in Scotland, midfielders trot about like headless chickens, feel sorry for strikers. Gray clueless. No plan. No tactics. Blah, blah, blah after game as usual but won't resign. Board have to act.

SMcDhfc: David Gray has lost the team, it was obvious tonight. As an attacking force, we were shocking, lots of huffing and puffing but not one real effort on target. The players should be embarrassed after that display, but they will get the result they are after, Gray sacked.

Craig: I like Gray but believe it's time he goes. He has one formation. It's just not good enough. But, if he goes, Malky MacKay [director of football] should go too. His signings have been terrible.

articles.title: El Martínez Valero deja de ser un fortín: tres derrotas en tres partidos
articles.standfirst: El Elche ya ha perdido más partidos en casa esta temporada que en toda la pasada
articles.summary: El Elche ya ha perdido más partidos en casa esta temporada que en toda la pasada
articles.body: El Elche juega como nunca, pero en el Martínez Valero pierde como nunca. La derrota ante el Real Madrid (2-3) volvió a dejar al conjunto franjiverde sin premio en su propio estadio y confirmó una tendencia especialmente preocupante: el equipo de Martín Anselmi ya suma tres derrotas como local esta temporada, una más que en toda la pasada campaña, cuando únicamente cayó ante el FC Barcelona y el Villarreal. El dato adquiere todavía más relevancia porque las tres derrotas del presente curso han llegado frente a Barcelona, Real Sociedad y Real Madrid. Tres de los rivales más exigentes del campeonato, pero también tres partidos en los que el Elche ha competido y ha tenido opciones de obtener un resultado positivo. Ante el Real Madrid, el conjunto ilicitano volvió a verse obligado a remar desde atrás. Arda Güler y Mbappé pusieron el 0-2 antes del descanso, haciendo valer la pegada y la jerarquía del conjunto blanco. Sin embargo, el Elche reaccionó tras el paso por los vestuarios y consiguió devolver la igualdad al marcador. La entrada de Lemar y Cepeda dio otro aire al equipo y Abiel Osorio recortó distancias en el minuto 71 con su primer gol de la temporada. Poco después, Fer Niño logró el 2-2, culminando una remontada que parecía posible ante un Madrid que había dado un paso atrás. Pero la historia volvió a repetirse. Como una semana antes frente a la Real Sociedad, el Elche se volcó en busca del triunfo y terminó recibiendo el golpe definitivo. Carlos Espí marcó el 2-3 en el tramo final, dejando al equipo de Anselmi nuevamente sin recompensa. El Elche deberá buscar ahora fuera de casa los puntos que se le están escapando en el Martínez Valero. La primera oportunidad llegará este viernes ante el Espanyol en Barcelona.

articles.summary: Los rojiblancos ansías confirmar su progresión... justo antes del derbi. Los rojillos tratan de superar el adiós de Braulio
articles.body: Aunque los triunfos siempre son el camino más recto para construir, el de esta tarde se presenta como todo un trampolín en los respectivos objetivos de Atlético y Osasuna de seguir creciendo. En el caso de los rojiblancos, no sólo porque serviría como confirmación de la progresión consumada frente a la Real Sociedad, sino porque dispararía la moral para llegar lanzados al derbi del domingo. En clave rojilla, por la necesidad de cortar el regusto que han dejado las dos últimas derrotas consecutivas y por la necesidad de superar el estado de shock al que ha llevado la repentina marcha de Braulio Vázquez rumbo al Valencia. Con el Atlético de vuelta al Metropolitano, también se recupera la necesidad de que el idilio que los de Simeone vienen manteniendo con su afición en las últimas siga siendo el fortín sobre el que cimentar la pelea por los títulos. Empezando por los puntos frente a Osasuna y siguiendo por el eterno rival. De ahí que, aunque impere el partido a partido, también se mire de reojo al domingo en lo que a posibles rotaciones se refiere. Por un lado, porque con numerosos mundialistas aún en busca de la forma ideal que no les permitió alcanzar una pretemporada al uso, tres encuentros en una semana no constituyen una situación ideal. Por el otro, porque la respuesta de los cuatro hombres que entraron de refresco en Anoeta para acabar decantando el resultado también supuso una reivindicación de que la segunda unidad está preparada para gozar de mayor protagonismo desde el inicio. Rotaciones que no serán exclusivas en el Atlético, pues la carga de partidos también invita a Ramis a mover el equipo. Más aún a sabiendas de la motivación que implica cortar la mala racha en un escenario como el Metropolitano.

articles.title: ‘Thank You, Colombia’: Captain James Rodríguez, 35, announces retirement from international football after extraordinary 15-year career
articles.summary: Football News: James Rodríguez, the iconic Colombian footballer, announces his retirement from international football after a remarkable 15-year career. He reflects on his journey, memorable moments, and contributions to Colombia's national team in an emotional farewell video.
articles.body: For 15 years, James Rodríguez was one of the first names that came to mind whenever Colombia walked onto a football pitch. The No. 10 shirt became closely associated with him, as did the captain’s armband, the spectacular goals and the expectations that followed him through three World Cups. On Tuesday, Rodríguez announced his international retirement in an emotional video, telling Colombian fans that it was time to close “one of the most important chapters” of his life. After 131 appearances for his country, the legendary No. 10 has brought that chapter to an end.From a winning debut to Colombia's record cap holderRodríguez's international story began in October 2011, when he made his Colombia debut against Bolivia and immediately announced himself by scoring the winning goal.He was only beginning what would become a 15-year relationship with the national team, eventually playing at the 2014, 2018 and 2026 World Cups. Colombia did not qualify for the 2022 tournament in Qatar, meaning Rodríguez's international career ultimately spanned three editions of football's biggest competition despite the four-year absence. He is tied with Carlos Valderrama and Freddy Rincon for the most tournament appearances by a Colombian.The tournament that defined his reputation, however, came in Brazil in 2014.Rodríguez scored six goals in five matches to win the World Cup Golden Boot, including the extraordinary volley against Uruguay in the last 16 that became one of the defining goals of the tournament and later won the FIFA Puskás Award.Colombia reached the quarter-finals before losing to hosts Brazil, but Rodríguez's performances had already changed the trajectory of his career. After the tournament, he earned his move from Monaco to Real Madrid, where he would play alongside some of the biggest names in world football.For Colombia, meanwhile, the No. 10 had become much more than a shirt number.Rodríguez eventually took on the responsibility of captaining his country as well, carrying the armband during a period in which Colombia remained one of South America's strongest sides.He finished his international career as Colombia's record cap holder, level with Carlos Valderrama and Freddy Rincón for the most tournament appearances by a Colombian, while his final figures stood at 131 appearances, 31 goals and 43 assists.The captaincy, the tears and one more World CupRodríguez's relationship with Colombia was never defined solely by the highlights.In his retirement message, he acknowledged the difficult periods alongside the celebrations and explained what representing the national team had meant to him throughout his career.“Today, I want to talk to you from the heart,” James said on social media on Tuesday. “After many years, many games and joys, and difficult moments, it's time to close one of the most important chapters in my life: my journey with the Colombian national team.”He described the responsibility attached to the shirt in equally personal terms.“Wearing this shirt was a dream, but also a huge responsibility,” James added. “Every time I entered a court, I understood that he didn't play just for me. I played for my family, teammates, thousands of Colombians who dreamed of all of us.“I had the honor of wearing the No. 10 shirt and also the captain's armband. I always tried to do it with respect, responsibility and understanding what it meant to represent Colombia. I had good days and very difficult ones, but I never stopped feeling proud of these colors.”His final appearance came on July 7, when Colombia faced Switzerland in the last 16 of the 2026 World Cup.The match finished 0-0 after extra time, before Switzerland won the penalty shootout 4-3, bringing Rodríguez's fourth and final World Cup campaign to an end.It also meant his last match for Colombia ended without the fairytale finish that might have suited the player who had given the country one of its most memorable individual World Cup performances.There had been another significant chapter two years earlier.Rodríguez captained Colombia to the 2024 Copa América final, where Argentina won 1-0 after extra time. It was Colombia's first appearance in the Copa América title match in 23 years, although Rodríguez ultimately finished his international career without a senior international trophy.Why James Rodríguez decided to walk awayHis announcement was direct, with Rodríguez making clear that his decision was not about distancing himself from Colombia but about bringing an important period of his life to a natural conclusion.The caption accompanying his retirement video said: “Thank you for every match, every joy, every tear and every dream we shared. Defending the colours of the Colombia national team was one of the greatest honours of my life.”He ended the message with the same sense of gratitude.“I'm leaving calmly because I gave everything. Thank you for every moment, thank you Colombia,” Rodríguez said.Rodríguez is now 35, and while his international career is finished, he has made clear that he is not finished with football.Rodríguez's club career continues in ColombiaJust last week, Rodríguez joined Atlético Nacional on a contract running through next June after leaving Minnesota United.The move takes him back to Colombian football for the first time since his teenage years at Envigado, where his professional career began, and gives the veteran midfielder an opportunity to continue playing in his home country after closing the door on international football.Atlético Nacional becomes the 14th club of a career that has taken Rodríguez through some of the biggest teams in Europe and North America, including Real Madrid, Bayern Munich and Everton.His club honours include two Champions League titles and two LaLiga crowns, while his international career produced the Golden Boot at the 2014 World Cup, 31 goals, 43 assists and more appearances for Colombia than any other player.There will be no more World Cup nights in the yellow shirt, no further Copa América campaigns and no additional occasions for Rodríguez to walk out wearing Colombia's No. 10 or captain's armband.For a generation of Colombian supporters, those two symbols had become inseparable from the same player.Now Rodríguez will try to write the final pages of his playing career at Atlético Nacional, while the Colombia team begins the task of imagining its midfield and its No. 10 shirt without the player who occupied both for so long.Get the latest Sports News and Live updates. articles.title: Barcelona - Racing: A un paso de la historia
articles.standfirst: Los culés pueden firmar el séptimo triunfo seguido por primera vez en su trayectoria
articles.summary: Los culés pueden firmar el séptimo triunfo seguido por primera vez en su trayectoria
articles.body: El Barça recibe esta noche la visita del Racing de Santander en un encuentro en el que los culés pueden hacer historia. Los de Flick encadenan seis triunfos, cinco en LaLiga y uno en la Champions League, y nunca antes han firmado siete. El rival invita al optimismo, no ha ganado este curso aún a domicilio y hace 22 años que no se impone a los culés. Los catalanes, que aspiran a afianzarse en el liderato, saben, no obstante, que no pueden relajarse: el Levante ya les hizo sufrir el pasado fin de semana. El Barcelona está lanzado. Enlaza seis victorias en este arranque, gesta que habían conseguido antes otros grandes Barça en las temporadas 1929-1930, 1960-1961 y 2018-2019. Pero nunca ha logrado ampliar esa gran racha a siete. Los de Flick pueden lograrlo esta noche si se imponen al Racing en el Spotify Camp Nou. Pero pese a su gran momento, los culés saben que no pueden fiarse de ningún rival. El pasado fin de semana, el Levante recortó distancias y se puso 2-3 tras un bajón de intensidad y concentración de los azulgranas. Los de Flick acabaron imponiéndose 2-4, pero fue una lección para los catalanes que confían haber aprendido. Quieren llegar al parón de selecciones líderes e invictos, y esa ambición no permite relajaciones, a pesar de que el Racing aún no ha puntuado a domicilio y hace 22 años que se impone a los culés. Para este encuentro, Flick introducirá cambios en la alineación. El germano, que tiene las bajas por lesión de Roony y De Jong, seguirá con las rotaciones: el sábado juegan en el Pizjuán. Así, hombres como Christensen, Olmo, Cancelo o Adeyemi pueden tener minutos frente al conjunto cántabro. Será, no obstante, un once muy competitivo en el que, a priori, se mantendrán en la línea ofensiva sus grandes realizadores: Raphinha y Lamine. El Racing llega a su duelo contra el Barcelona con la moral a tope después de vencer al Alavés en El Sardinero. Para este choque, José Alberto cuenta con las bajas de Andrés Martín y Eriksson, por lesión, y de Almeida por sanción. La gran amenaza racinguista es el delantero marroquí Zabiri, que lleva 5 goles en este inicio de campaña. El técnico asturiano no ha dado pistas sobre la posibilidad de hacer rotaciones en una semana de tres partidos, aunque futbolistas como Iker Luque o Pedro Felipe tienen opciones de salir de inicio. El Racing ya se enfrentó la pasada campaña al Barcelona en Copa de Rey perdiendo 0-2 en El Sardinero, pero dejando una muy buena imagen. A pesar de que el Racing hace muchos años que no visita el Spotify Camp Nou en Liga, el último precedente el 15 de octubre de 2011 donde perdió 3-0, tiene futbolistas en la actual plantilla que han jugado varios partidos ante el Barcelona en su estadio. Sergio Canales e Iván Martín, además, saben ganar de visitantes al conjunto catalán. El centrocampista cántabro lo hizo en dos ocasiones vistiendo la camiseta del Betis. En la campaña 2018-19 venció 3-4 y en la temporada 2021-22 ganó también 0-1. Por su parte, Iván Martín estuvo presente en el triunfo histórico del Girona 2-4 al Barcelona en la 2023-24.

articles.title: Max Dowman: Arsenal prodigy delivers latest statement performance as Mikel Arteta urges caution over 16-year-old
articles.summary: Max Dowman scored twice for Arsenal in their 4-2 win at Ipswich Town in the Carabao Cup third round; the 16-year-old forward was making his first appearance of the season; Dowman has had to wait for his chance after becoming the Premier League's youngest scorer
articles.body:
Mikel Arteta has managed the prodigy carefully since his big moment last season, when he became the Premier League's youngest scorer in a vital 2-0 home win over Everton on their title charge.

Dowman has played six times since then, mostly in cameos, and has been an unused substitute on four occasions this season. Last Saturday, he played an hour for the U21s in their 4-1 defeat to Chelsea while the first team won at Sunderland. Arteta warned Dowman afterwards that he must earn his minutes this season.

But Dowman did not have to wait long for his chance. While £63.5m striker Viktor Gyokeres failed to take his opportunity during Arsenal's 4-2 win over Ipswich in the Carabao Cup on Tuesday night , Dowman excelled, and the ease with which he scored twice was frightening.

His first, in just the seventh minute, came after he stole possession in midfield, burst onto the ball before Gyokeres, shimmyed past Cedric Kipre to leave the defender on the ground, before sending goalkeeper Christian Walton the wrong way with his weaker right foot.

"That's something very natural for him," said Arteta. "He can deliver those actions effortlessly. I would say that's his biggest quality."

Dowman had to be more precise for his second. Martin Zubimendi's pass deflected off Jacob Greaves's left arm, and Dowman, with little space inside the penalty area, adjusted to the ricochet with two quick touches to set up an accurate, composed shot on his left foot that almost trickled over the line, such was the perfectly measured weight of the effort.

Dowman's performance will only increase the hype around him. How will Arteta manage that?

"Well, it depends. If he does what he does on the pitch, it's not easy, I understand," said Arteta. "But what we have to do is look after him. He's 16 years old. You don't see that in this league. In other leagues in Europe, that's a totally different context.

"But in this league, with the demands that the league [has], the players and everything put on you, we really need to make sure every time we throw him in, he's in the right context with the right preparation. That's what we are trying to do."

It wasn't all about the goals at Portman Road. Dowman, who only completed his GCSEs in August, also showed his work rate off the ball, pressing Ipswich into a mistake for Noni Madueke's goal.

"Defensively, his application, his capacity as well to sustain the actions, is not easy," added Arteta.

"He's 16 years old, and he can create moments, but to consistently go through the game, every phase, with the demands that we put on them, to be able to do that is extremely difficult. And he's coping better and better and better.

"He did the action where he regained the ball and won it. In the first goal, he loses his man. And that's the thing that we need to continue to reiterate with him because he's an unbelievable player because of the character that he has and how much he loves to play at the biggest stage and still handle the situation with such naturality."

The evening wasn't even all about Dowman. Marli Salmon, 17, made only his second start for the first team and impressed at centre-back with an assured performance.

"Just having two 16-year-olds playing for Arsenal at this level against a Premier League team is so fulfilling," said Arteta. "Because I've been there and just to be able to contribute in somebody's career and dream, to be able to experience a game like tonight is just phenomenal.

"Medium and long term, we know that if they continue to develop in the way that they are, we're going to have two tremendous footballers for the future."

Dowman has benefited from Arsenal's stability under Arteta. The club has been able to nurture and develop him, without the distraction of cycling through managers. On the same day 15-year-old JJ Gabriel asked to leave Manchester United , Dowman made his latest statement on the pitch.

Arsenal fans will be desperate to see more of him. Arteta has warned it's not so easy to play him regularly.

"Everything is possible. The probability [of playing regularly] is probably extremely low because you don't see the players with the capacity to handle just the physicality of the game," he said.

"Not only that, but the demands that you have to put your body through in the week to be able to be in good condition to compete, the amount of information, the challenges that you have to face. But he's doing it and he's doing it really well every time there's a chance."

articles.summary: Es un partido para crecer. Leones y granotas vienen de tropezar la pasada jornada y no están para regalar. La intensidad de la semana anuncia rotaciones de Terzic
articles.body: La noche en el Ciutat de València ofrece una gran oportunidad para que los entrenadores de Levante y Athletic tomen conciencia de por dónde van sus equipos. Igual que en ámbitos como el de los maestros artesanos o los doctores de Ciencia, Castro y Terzic manejarán sus grupos desde un punto de vista iterativo, que es la base para la mejora y las soluciones a partir de evaluaciones, que en muchas de esas veces encuentran el mejor de los sentidos desde resultados negativos o circunstancias que alteren la sintonía. Y de ahí vienen Levante y Athletic: los primeros tras una derrota de honor frente al Barça y los rojiblancos tras perder aire en su globo de felicidad con un empate en casa ante el Elche. En puertas del derbi autonómico con el Villarreal, Luís Castro recuperará un once más reconocible que el que alineó ante el Barcelona. En principio, volverán a la titularidad Iván Romero y Bardeli, mientras que Tape podría debutar con la camiseta granota. El técnico no ofreció luz sobre el estado físico de sus futbolistas, pero mostró convencimiento en que la plantilla responderá a la exigencia planteada por el Athletic. El Levante pierde a Hugo Sotelo con respecto al encuentro del fin de semana con el Barça. El centrocampista gallego sufre un esguince de rodilla y no volverá hasta después de la ventana FIFA. Igual que ocurre con los levantinistas, a los leones les espera un derbi con el Alavés este sábado en San Mamés. Pero como lo que manda es el aquí y el ahora no pierden el foco de lo inmediato. Hay expectativa por ver cómo resuelve esta vez Terzic la punta de ataque después de no descartar que viaje Guruzeta. La semana de la ilusión será completa y atenderá al orden imaginado si vuelven de Orriols con puntos. En caso contrario, al técnico no le quedará otra que volver con urgencia al laboratorio de ensayo. El Athletic ha puntuado en sus cinco últimas visitas al Levante y en tres de esas oportunidades ha ganado. Romero vs Berenguer. El delantero del Levante marcó ante el Barcelona y fue parte importante en la sensación que tuvieron los de Luís Castro de que podían igualar el marcador en la recta final. Esa misma opinión se llevó el aficionado del Athletic con la entrada en el terreno de juego de Berenguer, que fue clave en el último empate. A pesar del empate ante el Elche, el Athletic ha demostrado fortaleza en las últimas jornadas. El Ciutat de València, donde esta temporada ya ha caído el Betis, será, sin duda, una dura prueba para los leones. El Levante es un equipo complicado, más si juega en casa. El pronóstico no es sencillo, pero apostamos por una victoria de los de Terzic, un equipo que está empezando ya a carburar.

articles.body: Dos de las grandes revelaciones de este inicio de LaLiga EA Sports 2026/2027 se enfrentan esta tarde (19.00 horas) en Riazor. El Dépor se ha adaptado a la perfección a una categoría que no pisaba desde hace ocho años y es el único equipo de LaLiga junto al Barcelona que no conoce la derrota. Por su parte, el Sevilla ha firmado un arranque que recuerda a tiempos pasados y afronta un nuevo reto antes de recibir al Barcelona el próximo sábado. Los de Antonio Hidalgo ven en la visita del Sevilla una oportunidad para afianzar la moral del grupo y ratificar el buen trabajo realizado. En el plano deportivo, se esperan cambios y rotaciones. articles.title: Liverpool 3-1 Tottenham: Player Ratings as Reds Knock Spurs Out of the EFL Cup
articles.summary: Liverpool hosted Tottenham Hotspur at Anfield this Tuesday, Sept. 15, for the third round of the EFL Cup. Here are the player ratings for both sides. Andoni...
articles.body:
Liverpool hosted Tottenham Hotspur at Anfield this Tuesday, Sept. 15, for the third round of the EFL Cup. Here are the player ratings for both sides.

Andoni Iraola 's side were coming off a 0-0 draw against Fulham on Sept. 12 and, before that, defeated Atlético de Madrid 2-1 on Sept. 9 in their debut in the current UEFA Champions League. On that night, Dominik Szoboszlai and Alexis Mac Allister scored for the Reds.

Meanwhile, Roberto De Zerbi's side has not been in a sweet spot, as they have not won a single Premier League match this season. In their most recent league match, they drew 0-0 against Everton on Sept. 12. Before that, on Sept. 5, they had also drawn 0-0 against Nottingham Forest , while on Aug. 29 they fell 2-0 to Newcastle United with goals from Anthony Elanga and Yoane Wissa .

Tottenham are currently buried in 17th place in the Premier League with just two points after four matches, with two draws and two defeats. Liverpool sit eighth with six points after four matches, with one win and three draws. The Reds have still not lost a Premier League match.

Liverpool won 3-1 and knocked Tottenham out of the EFL Cup. Mac Allister, Gakpo and Szoboszlai scored the goals for the Reds, while Gallagher scored Spurs ' only goal.

The MVP goes to Mac Allister, as he not only scored a goal but also provided an assist and attempted the most shots in the match, with four.

Gakpo also deserves an honorable mention, as he scored a goal and provided an assist, and he had the most touches in the opponent's box, with six. In Tottenham's case, both Gallagher and Bergvall had a good match, but it was not enough.

What's Next for Liverpool and Tottenham?

Following this third-round Carabao Cup match, Liverpool will travel to Vitality Stadium to face Bournemouth in the fifth matchweek of the Premier League on Sunday, Sept. 20.

Tottenham, meanwhile, will stay in London to host Aston Villa at Tottenham Hotspur Stadium on Saturday, Sept. 19, for the fifth matchweek of the Premier League, with the clear objective of finally getting their first league win of the season.

articles.title: ‘He’s extraordinary’ – Anthony Gordon goes crazy for Barcelona team-mate Pedri
articles.summary: ‘He's not particularly big or strong. But he's extraordinary.’
articles.body:
Anthony Gordon has been chatting about life at Barcelona and his new team-mates after making a bright start to life with Hansi Flick's side.

The England international joined the club in the summer from Newcastle and has settled in quickly, grabbing four assists already in La Liga.

He's now revealed how he was blown away when facing Barcelona last season in the Champiojns League and revealed just how much he admires new team-mate Pedri.

"I had never faced anyone who could control the game like they did in that match. And, to be honest, you had the two best players in the world in it. With Pedri and Frenkie de Jong," he told RAC1.

"Pedri doesn't stand out for his speed or physique. He's not particularly big or strong. But he's extraordinary. He has spectacular technical quality."

Gordon also revealed how he's also been impressed by the rest of squad, adding: "They are the best in the world in their positions and you would never think it when you meet them. Everyone is so humble."

articles.body:
Lionel Messi was on Tuesday named in Argentina's squad for a friendly against Benin on October 6, a match that will serve as his farewell appearance after announcing his international retirement last month.

The 39-year-old said in August he was retiring from Argentina duty after a two-decade international career that included winning the 2022 World Cup and Copa America triumphs in 2021 and 2024.

"We made the decision to invite the best player in the world, the symbol of our national team, our captain, Lionel Andres Messi, so that he can have the farewell he truly deserves on October 6 here in Argentina," said Argentine FA president Claudio Tapia.

The match against Benin will take place at River Plate's Estadio Monumental in Buenos Aires, which can accommodate 85,000 spectators.

Tapia also invited all of Argentina's 2022 World Cup winners to join Messi for what he said would be an "unforgettable" occasion.

Argentina begin a series of three friendlies against Bolivia on September 30 in Cordoba -- their first match since losing the World Cup final to Spain -- before taking on Burkina Faso in Buenos Aires on October 3.

Messi has been included in the squad for the third match against Benin, when he is expected to make his 208th and final appearance for the national team. He is Argentina's all-time record scorer with 125 goals.

Following the death of his father Jorge last month, Messi had said he had "serious doubts" about continuing to play football of any sort for "much longer".

"It was a decision that hurt and still hurts deep in my soul but I understand that it is the right time," Messi said when he called time on his Argentina career.

His contract with Major League Soccer club Inter Miami runs until the end of the 2028 season.

Last month FIFA ordered Argentina to play their next home match with capacity reduced to 50 percent for breaches of its disciplinary code relating to using a sports event for making demonstrations of a non-sporting nature.

After Argentina beat England 2-1 in a tense World Cup semi-final in July, several players held up a banner saying: "The Falklands are Argentine".

The friendlies are also expected to count towards suspensions handed down following incidents after Argentina's World Cup final defeat by Spain.

Midfielder Leandro Paredes received a 10-match ban, while defender Nahuel Molina was suspended for seven games and Thiago Almada for one.

articles.title: Kewan Lacy Addresses Lane Kiffin Relationship Ahead of HC's Return to Oxford for Ole Miss vs. LSU
articles.summary: Ole Miss running back Kewan Lacy discussed the team's upcoming game against LSU as the Rebels prepare to face former head coach and current Tigers coach Lane Kiffin.
articles.body:
Ole Miss running back Kewan Lacy discussed the team's upcoming game against LSU as the Rebels prepare to face former head coach and current Tigers coach Lane Kiffin.

Lacy revealed that he's maintained contact with several former Ole Miss assistant coaches and teammates that are now at LSU but "won't really talk to them until after the season," per the Associated Press (h/t ESPN ).

"I just want to be focused on the game plan and the game," Lacy said Tuesday.

He also explained that "I really don't have a relationship" with Kiffin, via ESPN.

Meanwhile, Ole Miss defensive tackle Will Echoles detailed his reaction to Kiffin departing the school during the 2025 season.

"I was planning on deer hunting in the woods that morning," Echoles said, via ESPN. "... A team meeting got called to announce [Golding] as the head coach.

"It didn't really hit me until the next day when I went to the weight room and [strength] coach [Nick] Savage wasn't there. That's when I realized there were coaches that weren't there anymore."

Although Kiffin helped the Rebels compile an 11-1 record to open their 2025 campaign, he left to sign a seven-year contract worth $91 million with LSU before the end of the season.

Pete Golding was promoted from defensive coordinator to head coach to replace Kiffin at Ole Miss, as the team finished with a 13-2 record and made a College Football Playoff semifinal appearance.

This season, the Rebels and Tigers both own 2-0 records heading into their matchup. Ole Miss took down Louisville and Charlotte to open the year, while LSU has defeated Clemson and Louisiana Tech.

Lacy has been a key factor in the Rebels' hot start, amassing 166 total yards and three touchdowns while averaging 4.9 yards per carry through two contests.

articles.title: Mourinho detecta el principal mal de su Madrid y le pone un nombre para la historia del fútbol: "Facilitismo"
articles.standfirst: "El facilitismo es es cuando todo parece fácil y tú dejas las cosas andar"
articles.summary: "El facilitismo es es cuando todo parece fácil y tú dejas las cosas andar"
articles.body: Jose Mourinho, entrenador del Real Madrid, recurrió una palabra inexistente para tratar de definir los problemas en el juego del equipo merengue en sus últimos partidos. Tras ganar en el descuento por 2-3 al Elche tras ir ganando 0-2, y sin olvidar los sufridos triunfos ante Rayo Vallecano (4-1) e Inter (2-1) cuando tenía los partidos controlados, Mou se refirió al "facilitismo" para diagnosticar los males competitivos de su equipo. "Parece que pasamos de la facilidad, porque estaba fácil. Parece que pasamos de esta facilidad a no controlar. Parece que entramos en una dinámica de "Ok". No hemos marcado. No hemos acabado con el 3-0 ó 4-0... pero está acabado", empezó argumentando el técnico luso. Mourinho se decidió a ponerle nombre al mal del Madrid: "Me parece un poco de, no sé si es la palabra correcta,... pero un poco de facilitismo". "Que es cuando todo parece fácil y tú dejas las cosas andar", subrayó Mou para definir el "facilitismo". Mourinho se extendió para hablar sobre las "desconexiones" que sufre su Real Madrid: ""El problema me parece obvio... Hay partidos que parecen acabados que no están acabados. La única explicación que encuentro es que son partidos fáciles, no matas... Partidos que no matamos y parece que pasamos de la facilidad a no controlar. Este tipo de estadio, lleno, afición fantástica... Lo ponen difícil. La cosa buena es que con la dificultad, el equipo reacciona y gana, que es lo más importante. Y cosa buena es que con los partidos del Madrid nadie se aburre, porque son muy divertidos". Mou también vio el lado bueno del triunfo del sufrido triunfo por 2-3 ante el Elche, destacando que "la cosa buenas es que de la dificultad, de la presión de perder puntos, el equipo reacciona".

articles.title: Meet the Scottish teenagers poised to represent Uganda
articles.summary: Teenage brothers Olly and Seb Fisher are closing in on their dream of international recognition - but it won't come from their homeland of Scotland.
articles.body:
Teenage brothers Olly and Seb Fisher are closing in on their dream of international recognition - but it won't come from their homeland of Scotland.

Instead, the Partick Thistle duo are in line to play for Uganda.

They believe they would become the first white players ever to represent the African nation, thanks to their mother Kate being born there.

"My gran and grandad lived out here for, I think, four or five years," Olly, 18, tells BBC Sport Scotland. "My grandfather came out here to teach in a school then my mum was born here. So, it's a bit of a strange one."

The siblings became aware of interest from Uganda about six months ago, following a chance conversation some time before between their father and a football consultant at a game in Nigeria.

And, at the start of August, they were invited to attend under-20 and under-17s training camps.

They spent last week in Jinja in the country's eastern region and will stay on for one more week, with the pair saying they're "shocked" and "honoured" at the call-ups.

"I couldn't believe it," 16-year-old striker Seb said. "It's one of those things you look at and you're shocked. You can't believe it. Most other people couldn't as well."

Goalkeeper Olly had a similar reaction. "A real mixture of emotions," he said. "I was quite shocked. I didn't really think that this was a possibility but I was honoured to be asked to represent Uganda. I thought it was a real big opportunity."

Mum Kate is "ecstatic" and "thinks it'd be a great experience for us", adds Seb.

There is another Scottish link with Uganda, with former Hearts and Ghana midfielder Laryea Kingston currently coach of Uganda's under-20s.

And he is the one who believes the Fisher brothers are on the verge of making history.

"Coach Kingston was saying we'd be the first white boys to play for Uganda, which would be history in the making," Seb explained. "It is very special."

And Olly added: "It's never been done before, so definitely it is very special."

The pair feel like they're making connections with the African nation, having been reared on stories about Uganda from their grandparents.

And even though they have been training in oppressively warm conditions, they are embracing the opportunity.

"Everyone has been brilliant, welcoming, really great," Seb said. "The other boys have been brand new with us. Some of the boys actually come from the same area where my mum was born. So, they were all talking about that."

The boys will return to Scotland soon, combining training and playing with Thistle with university and school, but are planning to rejoin their new international team-mates in the near future.

Olly hopes to be part of his squad if they qualify for the Under-20's Africa Cup of Nations early next year, and Seb could be in the Under-17 squad for November's World Cup in Qatar.

"That's what you want as a footballer, being in an international environment," Seb said. "It makes you a better player and hopefully it does for the two of us, and I think it will, and benefit us very much going back to Scotland playing at Thistle."

articles.title: Manchester derby VAR error caused by ‘tunnel vision’: Pro Ref chief Webb
articles.summary: Howard Webb says the referees’ body is disappointed with the decision to allow Haaland’s goal against Manchester United.
articles.body:
Pro Ref chief Howard Webb said “tunnel vision” led video assistant referee (VAR) officials to wrongly award Erling Haaland’s goal in Sunday’s Manchester derby at Old Trafford.

Haaland’s second-half strike was initially ruled out for offside before being allowed to stand following a VAR review that concluded the Manchester City forward was onside.

Pro Ref, the body responsible for refereeing in English professional football, later acknowledged the goal should not have been awarded because VAR failed to properly assess the involvement of teammate Enzo Fernandez, who attempted to play the ball from an offside position.

“I was really disappointed with this outcome. We all are. None more so than the officials themselves,” Webb, Pro Ref’s chief refereeing officer, said on Match Officials Mic’d Up on Sky Sports and TNT Sports.

“They take a lot of personal pride in what they do, and they’re obviously hurting now having fallen short in this situation.”

VAR is a refereeing support tool designed to enable the checking, reviewing and correction of clear and obvious errors during a match, according to FIFA. It was intended to be a combination of human expertise and technological accuracy, but has instead become a sour topic in football circles.

Current and former United players, including club legend Wayne Rooney, labelled the use of VAR “horrendous”, while football experts told Al Jazeera the technology has become “far too dominant” in decision-making.

Webb confirmed that VAR officials Matt Donohue and assistant VAR Blake Antrobus would not officiate again until after the international break.

“We’ve reached out to Manchester United and acknowledged the error, as we do when these things happen,” Webb said.

Explaining the decision-making process, Webb said the semi-automated offside system quickly established that Haaland was onside, but the VAR became overly focused on the striker’s position and failed to fully consider Fernandez’s influence on the play.

“But of course, when he then runs it back through the full APP, he doesn’t truly evaluate the full impact of Fernandez’s position,” Webb said.

“He has a look to see if he touches the ball, because then that relates to potentially knocking it to Haaland, who goes on to score. He doesn’t touch the ball, but he doesn’t truly evaluate other elements of offside. In that moment, he gets tunnel vision.”

Manchester United manager Michael Carrick criticised the decision after his side’s 1-0 home defeat, their second loss in four Premier League matches this season.

United next host Brighton in the League Cup on Wednesday before travelling to Fulham in the Premier League on Sunday.

articles.title: El Madrid pierde el control... y casi media Liga
articles.standfirst: Incomprensible segunda parte de los blancos en Elche • El equipo de Mou logró una renta cómoda, se echó atrás y estuvo a punto de dejarse otros dos puntos • Acabó con tres arietes
articles.summary: Incomprensible segunda parte de los blancos en Elche • El equipo de Mou logró una renta cómoda, se echó atrás y estuvo a punto de dejarse otros dos puntos • Acabó con tres arietes
articles.body: Ni en las peores pesadillas de un madridista se anticipó un final de partido como el que se vivió anoche en el Martínez Valero. El equipo de José Mourinho, que protagonizó una vibrante puesta en escena, se dejó ir en el segundo tiempo hasta ver esfumarse una ventaja de dos goles que hubiera sido una losa a mediados del mes de septiembre. El Barça recibe hoy al Racing y tampoco entra en los planes nada que no sea una victoria culé, con el equipo de Hansi Flick lanzado en este arranque de curso. El Madrid, mientras, emite sensaciones desconcertantes. Ayer, como ante el Rayo, fue un equipo arrollador en el primer tiempo e inexplicablemente sumiso en el segundo. Los goles de Arda y Mbappé parecían alfombrar el camino a un triunfo cómodo, ya que a los dos tantos se sumó un buen torrente de oportunidades desperdiciadas. Algo muy parecido a lo que pasó el pasado viernes ante el Rayo. Se pasó de un 3-0 a un 3-1 con opciones de un segundo gol rayista que no llegó porque Mou activó a Güler y el turco cerró el partido. En Elche fue titular y volvió a liderar al Madrid cuando el equipo quiso ser protagonista. Pero, tras el descanso, el paso atrás de los blancos fue escandaloso. Desapareció Arda, desaparecieron el resto de estrellas blancas y el partido pasó a ser casi un monólogo de los ilicitanos, que no desaprovecharon la cortesía de los visitantes. Primero recortaron distancias y metieron aún más el miedo en el cuerpo de un Madrid que ya había introducido cambios como los de Bellingham y Brahim, que en un momento de máximo agobio llegó a jugar como lateral derecho. Mou llenó el equipo de delanteros. De hecho, acabó con un triple nueve: Mbappé, Endrick y Espí. Además, en el campo abundaban los perfiles ofensivos (Brahim, Diomande, Jude...), lo que subió el partido a una montaña rusa de la que los blancos salieron vivos, de nuevo, gracias al olfato de Espí, que volvió a anotar un tanto salvador para su equipo. La euforia de un triunfo que acabó siendo épico en vez de lógico no borra el segundo tiempo del Madrid. Ante el Rayo, Mou atribuyó el bajón al físico, Ayer, en un once con hasta cinco caras nuevas, el problema fue de fútbol y de actitud. El equipo se dejó dominar en busca de una contra para cerrar el partido, pero el Elche no cayó en la trampa. Malas señales a cinco días del derbi en el Metropolitano.

articles.title: Así es la extraña lesión de Luis Rioja: se vuelve a romper la grasa plantar en la jugada del gol
articles.standfirst: Incómoda lesión que sufre el extremo hace semanas, se volvió a reproducir cuando marcó ya que el cuerpo alcanza una tensión límite en partido y se confiesa: "Vuelvo al origen"
articles.summary: Incómoda lesión que sufre el extremo hace semanas, se volvió a reproducir cuando marcó ya que el cuerpo alcanza una tensión límite en partido y se confiesa: "Vuelvo al origen"
articles.body: Luis Rioja lleva un inicio de temporada con el Valencia muy complicado. En el plano colectivo, como es evidente, y en el particular con dos lesiones que no le han permitido tener regularidad. Pero fue el que consumó la 'salvación' del Valencia en Vitoria gracias a su gol... y eso que su presencia fue 'un visto y no visto'. Entró en el minuto 63, marcó en el 78' y fue sustituido en el 80'. Al finalizar el encuentro, el extremo andaluz desvelaba la lesión que sufre y que no le permite rendir al ciento por ciento. Ha sufrido las últimas semanas una rotura de la grasa plantar de la que ha ido recuperándose poco a poco pero cuando estaba en la fase tierna de la recuperación ha vuelto a jugar y ha retrocedido todas casillas que había ganado con el tratamiento que llevaba. El autor del gol de la victoria se expresaba así tras el choque que supone la primera victoria de la temporada. “Es una lesión jodida. Tengo la grasa plantar rota. He querido jugar, quería jugar anteriormente. He intentado ayudar. Es diferente entrenar que competir... Es una jugada (la del gol) en la que apoyo de forma brusca y vuelvo al origen. Espero que no sea lo mismo y al menos me permita estar con el grupo", explicaba. La grasa plantar o almohadilla grasa plantar es una capa de tejido adiposo que se encuentra situada debajo del talón y la zona de los metatarsos que actúa como el amortiguador natural del pie. Atenúa hasta el 80% de la fuerza de cada pisada, protegiendo los huesos, nervios y articulaciones del impacto directo contra el suelo. Su estructura en forma de tabiques ayuda a repartir el peso del cuerpo de manera uniforme al caminar o correr. Cada choque de talón genera una fuerza 110% del peso corporal, que puede incrementarse en un 250% durante la carrera. Es lo que le sucedió a Rioja. En un momento de alta tensión corporal, que se da en un partido donde el cuerpo va hasta la extenuación -la jugada del gol ante el Alavés-, esa intensidad provoca una tensión multiplicada en la zona. Ocurre cuando el tejido pierde elasticidad o grosor por traumatismos repetidos. A menudo se confunde con la fascitis plantar.

articles.title: Gianluigi Donnarumma interview: Man City goalkeeper insists club are not in a transition year and backs club to have a great season
articles.summary: Man City goalkeeper Gianluigi Donnarumma speaks exclusively to Sky Sports' Sam Blitz about the club's faultless start to the campaign; after a summer of change, City have started on fire; watch Man City vs Sunderland live on Sky Sports this Sunday from 1pm, kick-off 2pm
articles.body:
It's been a few days since the Manchester Derby victory but sat at Man City's training ground, Gianluigi Donnarumma is still basking in the glory.

He's not interested in Erling Haaland's controversial winner - though he's still annoyed Phil Foden was "harshly" sent off earlier in the game - as something else pleased him. A man down, everything going against them - City showed mettle and won.

"I loved my team-mates' performance, it was sublime," he tells Sky Sports . "The capacity to stay in the game and to react to difficult moments - no one can take that away from us.

"We will give everything for this shirt, for this club that gives us so much and offers us so much great support. It has a great history, and we need to give a lot back to it."

Not many had City down to hold a 100 per cent record this season ahead of the upcoming, lengthy international break - especially after losing the core of a successful era in Pep Guardiola, Bernardo Silva, John Stones and Rodri.

City have not been entirely convincing in certain areas - even Donnarumma says there is still lots to learn despite the faultless start to the Enzo Maresca era. But this was meant to be a transition season at City.

"I don't really like the word 'transition.'" he adds. "The club's objective is to win. This team's objective is to win. We'll certainly give everything we can to achieve that.

"We could reach the end of the season having won something, or having won nothing. But what's important is having a winning mentality, going out there and trying to win everything we possibly can."

Part of that winning mentality is being driven by Donnarumma - who is part of a newly-formed leadership group that replaced the likes of Bernardo, Stones and Rodri.

Donnarumma sits alongside Ruben Dias in the leadership pecking order, along with Haaland and Marc Guehi. All four players have one thing in common: they all have won trophies both at City and at other clubs in their careers.

So as the likes of Ayyoub Bouaddi, Elliot Anderson and Ilimian Ndiaye settle into their new team - tasked with making an immediate impact in a non-transition year - the leadership quartet are there to drive the standards.

"We've changed a few players. A few new ones have arrived," says Donnarumma. "They're all top players who are used to playing on the biggest stages, dealing with certain situations, and playing in the Premier League.

"It's not easy at the beginning when you move to a new club, a new organisation, a new city. But they're adapting well, and we're making them feel comfortable.

"The players who were already here are helping them a lot. I think we're going to have a great season.

"The objective is to get to the end and compete for everything there is to compete for - in addition to the Premier League, there's the Champions League and the two domestic cups."

It's a clear warning from City that anything is possible when it comes to this team. But when it comes to Donnarumma's aim of challenging for the Premier League and the Champions League, one team stands in the way: Arsenal.

Mikel Arteta's side have also started the season with five straight wins - and have the added recent psychological boost of pipping City to the Premier League post last May.

The recent Guardiola documentary showed down and disappointed scenes from City players as they slipped up at Bournemouth to hand the Gunners the title. Donnarumma - who had won the league title in each of the previous five seasons before last term - was one of them.

"It's difficult, but that's football, that's life. You're not on your own," he says about that disappointment. "There are other strong teams, especially in the Premier League.

"It's not that if you don't win there isn't disappointment - of course there is - but it can happen because there are other teams as well, just like in the Champions League.

"It's important to go into every game trying to win it. Certainly, our objective will be to win, but there are other teams too.

"You have to compete, you have to work, and you have to do everything possible because the history of this club demands it."

Will it be City and Arsenal again competing at the top come May? "I don't know. We're only four games into the season," says the Italian goalkeeper.

But the stall has been set out. "Our focus right now has to be on working and trying to win every game. That has to be our objective.

"Whether we achieve it in the end or not, only time will tell."
